english.title: Knowingly concerned in fraudulent evasion of prohibition / restriction on a weapon / ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was knowingly concerned in

(A)_[a fraudulent evasion]_
(B)_[a fraudulent attempt at evasion]_

of a

(C)_[prohibition]_
(D)_[restriction, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..),]_

on the

(E)_[importation]_
(F)_[exportation]_

of

(G)_[weapons]_
(H)_[ammunition]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(2), (3) and (4A)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly concerned in a
fraudulent evasion / attempt at evasion
of a prohibition in force
on the importation / exportation of
weapons / ammunition

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of three times the value of the goods or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.
